title: Out-of-domain replication — FRANK-CNN/DM (extractive-leaning)
what_this_is: The second half of the FRANK replication: CNN/DailyMail-derived summaries (more extractive than XSum). Together with the XSum card it brackets how each judge behaves as text moves from extractive to abstractive.

results.note: Strong in-distribution-like performance on extractive text; contrast with 0.21 on the XSum half — lexical overlap is a fair judge only where summaries reuse source wording.
Essentially identical to its XSum value (0.2902) — the NLI judge is the STABLE one across the extractive/abstractive divide, which is what a defensible default needs.

scope_limits: Higher lexical correlation here does NOT make the lexical scorer a good judge in general — the XSum card shows why (paraphrase/abstraction defeats it, the original F18 finding).
reading_guidance: Read paired with the XSum card. A judge whose validity depends on the text being extractive is a judge whose validity must be re-checked per corpus — the card family exists to make that explicit.
